verdict.rationale: SavvyCal documents registrable outbound webhooks. You add them under Settings > Integrations, and they deliver HTTP POSTs on account changes with named event types such as event.created. Deliveries are signed with SHA-256 HMAC, retried with exponential backoff up to 20 attempts, and recorded in a per-webhook request log. Custom metadata can be passed through, and workflows offer a timed 'Send a webhook' action. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and a full catalogue of event types in the evidence.
